# Templates

**Background.** An advanced section for people who choose or make Templates.

A **Template** is a page design: layout, fonts and the kinds of document it
offers. A **Configuration** adapts a Template to an organisation with a name, a
logo and colours. Both are folders of files. You do not need this section to
write documents or bind a Template to a Collection.

| Page | What it covers |
|------|----------------|
| [Template catalogue](catalogue/README.md) | The Templates that ship with Outprint. Generated from the packages. |
| [Template author guide](template-author-guide.md) | Write your own Template, with a worked example. |
| [Try your Template](try-your-template.md) | Render and validate before you roll out. |

The exact syntax is in [Reference](../reference/README.md).
